reference: Huawei KML 25.1.0 with private GCC 12.3.1; not specified official KML 25.2.0

members.strategy: 已晋级T8-svepanel16原样三轮复测，建立本轮KML25.1/GCC12基线；后续以同版本新run和候选同分配交错比较。

From T8, use a 4-row x 32-column SVE update for complete 32-column regions of the large path. Reuse four L coefficients across four RHS vectors, preserving increasing-k FMA, one final C subtraction, KB256/CT64, packing, scheduling, tails and fallback. More X input bytes are an explicit tradeoff; test actual performance against T8.

From T13-sve4x32, change only the large-path row/column CT constant from 64 to 128. Keep KB256, all kernels, arithmetic, packing, barriers, fallbacks and small path. Compare with unchanged T13 to isolate tile scheduling/reuse; promotion remains against current T8 baseline.

From T13-sve4x32, change only the large-path row/column CT constant from 64 to 32. Keep KB256, all kernels, arithmetic, packing, barriers, fallbacks and small path. Compare with unchanged T13 to isolate tile scheduling/reuse; promotion remains against current T8 baseline.
